leagues.quote: Participan automáticamente por el título de Campeón de la [[Primera División de México|Liga BBVA MX]], los ocho primeros clubes de la tabla general de clasificación al término de las 17 jornadas.
leagues.note: Two independent 17-round tables of 18 clubs; the table only seeds the liguilla, so the champion is a play-off, not the table. Top 8 straight to a two-legged liguilla (quarter-finals 25-29 November, semi-finals 2-6 December, final 10/13 December, or 24/27 December if Toluca reach it because of the FIFA Intercontinental Cup). Play-in gone for good from Apertura 2026: 'La asamblea de dueños de la liga determinó la supresión definitiva del sistema de Play-In, para volver al sistema donde únicamente los ocho primeros lugares de la tabla general avanzan de manera directa a la fase final del torneo.' Nothing carries between the two tournaments; the combined 2026 table only seeds the Leagues Cup. No relegation: art. 35 of the 2026-27 regulations says the Liga MX clubs 'no descenderán a la Liga de Expansión MX'. Clausura 2027 has no article yet, so its window is Clausura 2026 a year on (17 rounds, 9 January - 26 April regular phase, final 24 May).

leagues.quote: Participan automáticamente por el título de Campeón de la [[Liga de Expansión MX]], los ocho primeros clubes de la tabla general de clasificación al término de las 15 jornadas.
leagues.note: 16 clubs, 15-round tables, Apertura + Clausura, top 8 to a two-legged liguilla: Apertura 2026 quarter-finals 4-8 November, semi-finals 11-15 November, final 21 and 28 November. The preliminary knockout round was already abolished in 2024-25. Closed upward in 2026-27: no promotion to Liga MX, and membership still moves by franchise sales (Piratas bought Celaya's place, Cruz Azul Hidalgo entered as an affiliate); the season article states no relegation rule, so relegation is left unknown. Clausura 2027 has no article yet, so its window is Clausura 2026 (15 clubs) a year on.

leagues.quote: La '''Liga de Fuerzas Básicas de México''' son torneos disputados por las categorías menores de los clubes de la [[Primera División de México]].
leagues.note: Liga MX Sub-19 is a Fuerzas Básicas category, one team per Liga MX club (18), run as an Apertura and a Clausura tournament every year (the per-category palmares lists A-2025 and C-2026). No 2026-27 calendar, knock-out format or dates for the category are published on Wikipedia, and sub19.ligamx.net was not readable, so both windows stay null. The row is the whole year-round category, not one tournament; the champion is decided somewhere in the youth knock-outs, about which nothing reliable was found.
